issues.text: The [Authorize] check is drawn as a self-call on OrdersController. With app.UseAuthorization() (Program.cs:110) the attribute is evaluated before Get runs, outside the controller's code; the lesson's own prose says 'checked before the endpoint's code runs'. The self-arrow suggests the controller's code performs it.
issues.fix: Replace with a note before the controller acts, e.g. `Note over C,OC: [Authorize] before Get runs: no valid token -> 401`, or change the label to `[Authorize] (before Get runs): valid token? If not, 401`.

issues.text: The diagram step says [Authorize] checks for a valid token and answers 401, but the section 4 prose only says the attribute 'is checked before the endpoint's code runs', not what it checks. I learn the 401 part only in section 5 ('Two layers work here'). I can still narrate the diagram, so this is minor.
